purpose: Additive legal document ingestion; preserve existing legal JSON schemas and records.
non_negotiable_rules: Never delete or rewrite the existing legal corpus as part of ingestion.
Never overwrite an existing document or article based only on title similarity.
Keep discovery source separate from final issuing authority.
Keep uncertain, incomplete, conflicting, or unverified documents in review staging.
Keep original PDF, extracted text, checksum, provenance, and version history.
Do not automatically reactivate quarantined legal data.

majles.role: preferred discovery and verification source for laws passed by Parliament

ekhtebar.role: discovery and indexing source; not standalone proof of authenticity or current legal effect

issuing_court_or_judiciary.role: final source verification for judicial decisions and advisory opinions

import_policy.new_document: Append only to the matching existing JSON category after validation.
import_policy.amendment: Retain as a separate amendment/version and link to the base document; do not silently consolidate.
import_policy.duplicate: Do not import; record duplicate_of and preserve provenance.
import_policy.uncertain_or_conflicting: Set workflow_status=needs_review; do not add to active search corpus.
import_policy.quarantine: Never reactivate without a separate explicit source-backed review.
import_policy.runtime_index: Refresh through a controlled reload/restart after a successful atomic import; never mutate active files mid-request.
